spec.semantic_summary: Keep target-supported far pointers and clipping; test a library copy idiom versus the byte loop for the target’s paired REP word/byte row transfer.
binding_evidence: Target row body splits a computed byte count into REP MOVSW and REP MOVSB.
Huge pointers were ruled out: their candidate produced eight extra KERNEL selector obligations and an overlong body.

axes.name: row_copy_idiom
axes.rationale: Target uses both REP MOVSW and REP MOVSB; test the standard bulk-copy call and a direct byte loop under the assigned /Oelw profile.
values: for (col = 0; col < copyBytes; col++) destination[col] = source[col];

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
